InstanceSetup.TipAdvanceRun:
This option does not override global settings: when launching, the global command runs first, then the version's command.

Runs a specific command or program before MC launches, with the same syntax as the Windows command prompt.

You can use replacement tokens to change its content dynamically or to build relative paths; search “replacement tokens” in More → Help to learn how. For example:
 · "{verpath}test.exe": runs test.exe in the version folder
 · "{java}java.exe" -jar "{verpath}test.jar": runs test.jar in the version folder with Java
 · notepad "{verindie}options.txt": opens this version's settings file in Notepad

When the command runs, the working directory is the current .minecraft folder.

PageOtherAbout.HintThanks: Thanks to everyone who helped make PCL better:
Text_DefaultIsolationTip:
When a new version is installed, its isolation option is set automatically based on this.
To adjust the isolation policy of an existing version, go to its version settings.
Text_IsoOffTip:
All versions use the same profile; saves, Mods, resource packs and so on are shared.
If several versions with Mods are installed, Mod conflicts may occur.
Text_IsoMod: Isolate versions that can install Mods
Text_IsoModTip: Versions that can install Mods (such as Forge and Fabric) are isolated from each other to avoid Mod conflicts, while other versions (such as vanilla) are not isolated.
Text_IsoSnapshotTip: Isolate Minecraft snapshots, pre-releases, ancient versions and April Fools versions from other versions.
Text_IsoModAndSnapshotTip: Isolate Mod-capable versions, Minecraft snapshots, pre-releases, ancient versions and April Fools versions from other versions.
Text_IsoAllTip:
Saves, Mods, resource packs and so on are not shared between different versions.
This means saves cannot be shared between different vanilla versions, so it is generally not recommended.
Text_WindowTitleTip:
Customizes the title of the game window; leave it blank to keep it unchanged.
You can use replace markers to change its content dynamically; search “replace markers” in More → Help for usage.
Text_CustomInfoTip:
Note: Mojang removed this setting in Minecraft 26.1, so it has no effect in newer versions.

This info is shown in the lower-left corner of the game's main screen and the upper-left corner of the F3 debug screen.
You can use replace markers to change its content dynamically; search “replace markers” in More → Help for usage.
Text_VisClose: Close immediately after the game launches
Text_VisHideClose: Hide after the game launches, close automatically when the game exits
Text_VisHideOpen: Hide after the game launches, reopen when the game exits
Text_VisKeep: Stay unchanged after the game launches
Text_PriorityHigh: High (prioritizes the game for better game performance, but may cause lag in other programs)
Text_PriorityLow: Low (prioritizes other programs, but may cause game lag; suitable when idling)
Text_WinCustomTip: A few versions such as Forge 1.12.2 have a bug that makes the height setting ineffective
Text_RamAutoTip: Dynamically adjusts the memory allocated to the game based on the number of installed Mods and the computer's free memory
Text_RamOptimize: Run memory optimization before launching the game
Text_RamOptimizeTip:
Memory optimization can reduce current physical memory usage by about one third, and not only for MC!
If you use a mechanical hard drive, it may also cause severe lag for a short while.
Starting PCL with the --memory argument runs memory optimization silently.
Text_SkinVersionHint: Because the version is too old or for other reasons, the currently selected MC version cannot load the skin configured here. To change the skin, go to Multiplayer → Official account management.
Text_SkinRandom: Randomly use a skin from the library on each launch
Text_SkinRandomTip: Randomly use the skins of all signed-in accounts in Multiplayer → Official account management, or use a skin configured through another channel (such as LittleSkin)
Text_SkinOfficial: Only use the skin of the currently selected account
Text_SkinOfficialTip: Force the skin of the currently selected account to be used, even if that account has no skin configured
Text_SkinCustomTip: Use a custom skin selected from local files
Text_JvmArgumentsTip:
Leave it blank to use PCL's built-in optimized arguments. If you don't want to use PCL's arguments, enter your own.
You can learn the exact arguments for both cases in More → Help.
Text_GameArgumentsTip:
Appended to the end of the arguments when launching the game; you can set arguments such as --server here.
You can use replace markers to change its content dynamically; search “replace markers” in More → Help for usage.
Text_PreLaunchCmdTip:
A CMD command run before the game launches.
You can use replace markers to change its content dynamically; search “replace markers” in More → Help for usage.
Text_WaitCmdComplete: Wait for the command to finish before launching the game
Text_JavaListTip: Choose which Java to use to launch the game; leaving it blank for automatic selection is recommended.
Text_GcZGCTip: Available on Java 15+; uses more memory than G1GC, but almost never causes lag when reclaiming memory.
Text_GcGenZGCTip: Available on Java 21+; uses more memory than G1GC, but almost never causes lag when reclaiming memory.
Text_GcG1GCTip:
Uses generational ZGC on Java 21+, non-generational ZGC on 20–15, and G1GC on 14-.
ZGC uses more memory than G1GC, but does not cause lag when reclaiming memory.
Overrides the GC-related arguments in the “Java VM arguments” setting.
Text_GcPCLG1GCTip:
Uses generational ZGC on Java 21+, and G1GC on 20-.
ZGC uses more memory than G1GC, but does not cause lag when reclaiming memory.
Overrides the GC-related arguments in the “Java VM arguments” setting.
Text_GcCustomTip:
Always uses G1GC, with Mojang's official optimization arguments.
G1GC uses less memory than ZGC, but causes sudden lag when reclaiming memory.
Overrides the GC-related arguments in the “Java VM arguments” setting.
Text_DisableLUATip: Disabling it may prevent the game from launching
Text_HighPerfGPUTip: Only useful on computers with dual GPUs
Text_VerifySSL: Force the download tool to verify SSL certificates
Text_VerifySSLTip: Disabling it can fix download errors in some network environments
Text_MoreAdvanceHint: For more advanced settings, see Version settings → Settings.
Text_DisableJLWTip:
Whether to use Java Launch Wrapper to fix the problem where Java 18- may fail to launch under a Chinese path.
See: https://github.com/00ll00/java_launch_wrapper
